metadata.title: Thoda Dance: A movement saves tribal dance | हाटी समुदाय का ठोडा नाच कैसे बचेगा
metadata.description: The communities of trans giri area of Himachal Pradesh are known as Hatti. This area has a very distinct culture and life style. Among many forms of dances the Thoda dance is very unique and ancient folk dance of this area. There is a myth that this dance belong to the Mahabharata era.
